authority: Owner ruling 2026-10-15: dispose of the shared PGDATA two-writer risk before continuing the three-database build; the leftover sc-backend-odoo-prod db/redis pair is retired through a governed entry, not an ad-hoc docker stop.
purpose: Single declaration of the leftover stack that must stay stopped. The routing inventory refuses the daily runtime while a container listed here is running, and refuses while two live postmasters own one cluster data directory.

survivor.description: the live daily development stack that keeps the shared volumes

probes.name: live_postmaster_facts
argv: SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time(), pg_is_in_recovery(), pg_current_wal_lsn(), system_identifier FROM pg_control_system()

probes.name: live_cluster_databases
argv: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false ORDER BY datname

probes.name: live_cluster_checkpoint
argv: SELECT checkpoint_time, checkpoint_lsn, timeline_id FROM pg_control_checkpoint()

stacks.why_retired: second live postmaster on sc_dev_db_data and a second redis writer on sc_dev_redis_data, with no application consumer; proven by two distinct pg_postmaster_start_time() values on one shared pg_control inode.
